Message.En:
In the <COL ffdc78> "Limit Breaking Arms"</COL>
at the Custom-Made Workshop, you can perform it
as many times as you want by obtaining the
following two things: ① Weapons and armor
enhanced up to ★4 ② Required costs such as
materials and Rift Crystals Also, the <COL ffdc78>granted
abilities are overwritten every time you attempt
the Limit Break</COL>, so proceed while
confirming examples of granted
abilities upon success.
Message.Jp:
カスタムメイド工房での<COL ffdc78>《武具のリミット解除》</COL>は

何度でも行うことができます
　①★４まで強化された武器や防具
　②素材やリムなどの必要な費用
